newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Mostly steady on call, no trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Mostly steady on call, no trade.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session Monday. No barges traded versus none Friday.
- Two barges, Memphis, Mississippi River, this week, no bid, offer 90 percent, unchanged and similar from July 18.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 100 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, similar from July 17 unchanged, bid 115 percent, no offer.
- One barge, Hennipin, Illinois River, on station, no bid, offer 105 percent, no comparison.
- Five barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of August, no bid, offer 135 percent, no comparison.
